Author:     Magnus Melin <mkmelin+mozilla@iki.fi>

    Bug 2001067 - setting requesttimeoutfactor for Linux 24.04 CCov was not happening. r=tobyp
    
    The 24.04 do not have the -qr postfix...
    This cause the CCov builds to not get enough timeoutfactor. This test requires a double requesttimeoutfactor
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D275362

diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/test/tests.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/test/tests.yml
index d0b7152532d..9f27da7cf99 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/test/tests.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/test/tests.yml
@@ -50,7 +50,8 @@ xpcshell:
     timeoutfactor:
         by-test-platform:
             linux.*64-asan-qr/opt: 2
-            linux.*64-ccov-qr/opt: 4
+            linux1804-64-ccov-qr/opt: 4
+            linux.*64-ccov/opt: 4
             linux.*64-tsan-qr/opt: 3
             linux.*64/debug: 2
             macosx1015-64.*: 6
title: Bug 2001067 - setting requesttimeoutfactor for Linux 24.04 CCov was not happening. r=tobyp
